record: little-endian Float32 x4 = 16 bytes: [x, y, z, M_K]

fields.z: Mpc toward the north celestial pole
fields.M_K: absolute Ks magnitude (Ktmag - 5 log10(d/10 pc)); lower = brighter; records sorted by it

distance: cz_CMB / H0 (Hubble law, no peculiar-velocity correction); cz_CMB = barycentric cz + 369.82 km/s toward l=264.021, b=48.253 (Sun vs CMB, Planck 2018)
cuts: skipped 1066 without redshift and 53 with cz_CMB < 300 km/s, of 44599
source: 2MASS Redshift Survey (2MRS), Huchra et al. 2012, ApJS 199, 26; VizieR J/ApJS/199/26 table3 (Ks <= 11.75, |b| > 5 deg, 8 deg near the Galactic centre)
